data.credibility: Management frequently guides on targets and then drops tracking or discussion in subsequent quarters. For longer horizons, guidance is initially raised or reiterated before going unmentioned, showing limited long-term accountability.

lines.line: Promised 2,100 Blinkit stores by Dec Qtr; dropped with no actuals reported.
Targeted 3,000 Blinkit stores by March 2027; dropped without final results.
Guided 15% food delivery growth for FY26; dropped from subsequent updates.
Expected District losses to improve in FY27; topic was subsequently dropped.
Expected District breakeven in 4-6 quarters; dropped without fulfillment tracking.
Targeted 30% going-out NOV CAGR; dropped before horizon completion.
Maintained $3B going-out NOV guidance for FY30; dropped in later quarters.
Guided 60% quick commerce CAGR; actual reached 113.7% with status kept on track.
Targeted 3-3.5% quick commerce EBITDA margin; actual achieved 3.0%.

overrides.reason: Actual growth of 113.7% exceeds the guided 60% CAGR.
Actual EBITDA margin of 3.0% falls within the 3-3.5% target range.
